internal.title: Incident Resolved: Cart Service Error Rate Spike Due to Feature Flag
internal.body:
At 10:36 UTC, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the cart service. Diagnosis identified the root cause as a Valkey connection error linked to the cartFailure feature flag. The flag was disabled at 10:56 UTC after approval, resulting in immediate recovery of the service error rate to normal levels. The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on customer transactions.

Timeline:
- 10:36:27: Alert received for high error rate in cart service.
- 10:56:09: Diagnosis confirmed cartFailure flag as cause.
- 10:56:11: Flag disabled after approval.
- 10:56:11: Service error rate returned to normal.

Actions Taken:
- Disabled the cartFailure feature flag to stop the fault injection.

Verification:
- Service error ratio dropped from 0.5 to 0.002 within minutes post-action.

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: Some customers experienced issues adding items to cart
external.body: Between 10:36 and 10:56 UTC, some customers experienced issues adding items to their shopping cart due to a temporary service disruption. The issue was identified and resolved by our operations team within 20 minutes. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are taking steps to prevent similar issues in the future.

output.summary: A temporary increase in error rates in the cart service was caused by a feature flag inducing a connection error, which was promptly disabled to restore service.
output.impact: Some customers were unable to add items to their cart for approximately 20 minutes, potentially affecting their shopping experience.
output.root_cause: The root cause was a Valkey connection error triggered by the cartFailure feature flag, which was intentionally injecting faults for testing purposes but was active in production.
output.resolution: The cartFailure feature flag was disabled after diagnosis and approval, resulting in immediate recovery of the cart service error rate to normal levels.

lessons.lesson: Feature flags that inject faults should have strict controls and monitoring to prevent accidental activation in production environments.
lessons.applies_when: When a fault-injecting feature flag is enabled in production causing service errors.

action_items: Review and enhance controls around fault-injecting feature flags to prevent accidental activation in production.
Implement automated alerts specifically for fault-injection flags being enabled in production environments.
